name: aio-html-artifacts
description: Create self-contained HTML artifacts in four genres — report, deck, explorer, editor — routed by what the human does next: read and audit, present, decide, or edit and hand values back. Every artifact is offline (one file, zero remote references), printable (a print stylesheet in every genre), and auditable (claims carry repository, revision, and line anchors, confidence words carry numeric bands, and a parsing validator gates the structure).
